```javascript
// CopyCat Media Player (VLCopyCat) — Audio & Media Playback Engine (ES6)
// Controls an HTML5 MediaElement, synchronizes bidirectionally with PlayerState (src/state.js),
// and implements VLC's 200% Cone Volume Boost via the Web Audio API GainNode.

import { playerState, VOLUME_MIN, VOLUME_MAX, SPEED_MIN, SPEED_MAX } from './state.js';

const SEEK_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 0.35;
const MEDIA_SOURCE_MAP = new WeakMap();

function clamp(value, min, max, fallback) {
  const num = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) {
    return fallback;
  }
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, num));
}

export class AudioEngine {
  #media = null;
  #state = null;
  #audioContext = null;
  #sourceNode = null;
  #gainNode = null;
  #unsubscribers = [];
  #domListeners = [];
  #isApplyingState = false;
  #isUpdatingFromMedia = false;

  /**
   * @param {HTMLMediaElement|null} [mediaElement=null] - Target <video> or <audio> element.
   * @param {import('./state.js').PlayerState} [stateManager=playerState] - Central PlayerState instance.
   * @param {object} [options={}]
   * @param {boolean} [options.useWebAudio=true] - Enable Web Audio API GainNode for >100% volume boost.
   */
  constructor(mediaElement = null, stateManager = playerState, options = {}) {
    this.#state = stateManager || playerState;
    this.useWebAudio = options.useWebAudio !== undefined ? Boolean(options.useWebAudio) : true;

    this.#bindStateSubscriptions();

    if (mediaElement) {
      this.attachMediaElement(mediaElement);
    }
  }

  // ==================== MEDIA ELEMENT LIFECYCLE ====================

  /**
   * Attaches an HTML5 <video> or <audio> element to the engine and syncs current state.
   * @param {HTMLMediaElement} mediaElement
   * @returns {this}
   */
  attachMediaElement(mediaElement) {
    if (!mediaElement || typeof mediaElement !== 'object') {
      throw new TypeError('AudioEngine.attachMediaElement requires a valid HTMLMediaElement.');
    }

    if (this.#media === mediaElement) {
      return this;
    }

    this.detachMediaElement();
    this.#media = mediaElement;

    this.#attachDomListeners();
    this.#syncMediaFromCurrentState();

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Detaches the currently bound HTMLMediaElement and removes all DOM event listeners.
   */
  detachMediaElement() {
    if (!this.#media) {
      return;
    }

    for (const { event, handler } of this.#domListeners) {
      if (typeof this.#media.removeEventListener === 'function') {
        this.#media.removeEventListener(event, handler);
      }
    }
    this.#domListeners = [];

    if (this.#sourceNode) {
      try {
        this.#sourceNode.disconnect();
      } catch {
        // Ignore disconnect errors if already disconnected
      }
      this.#sourceNode = null;
    }

    this.#media = null;
  }

  /**
   * Returns the currently attached HTMLMediaElement, or null.
   * @returns {HTMLMediaElement|null}
   */
  get mediaElement() {
    return this.#media;
  }

  // ==================== WEB AUDIO API (200% VLC BOOST) ====================

  #ensureAudioGraph() {
    if (!this.useWebAudio || !this.#media) {
      return false;
    }

    const AudioCtx = (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined')
      ? (globalThis.AudioContext || globalThis.webkitAudioContext)
      : null;

    if (!AudioCtx) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      // Reuse existing AudioContext & MediaElementAudioSourceNode if already created for this element
      if (MEDIA_SOURCE_MAP.has(this.#media)) {
        const cached = MEDIA_SOURCE_MAP.get(this.#media);
        this.#audioContext = cached.audioContext;
        this.#sourceNode = cached.sourceNode;
        this.#gainNode = cached.gainNode;
        return true;
      }

      if (!this.#audioContext || this.#audioContext.state === 'closed') {
        this.#audioContext = new AudioCtx();
      }

      this.#sourceNode = this.#audioContext.createMediaElementSource(this.#media);
      this.#gainNode = this.#audioContext.createGain();
      this.#gainNode.gain.value = 1.0;

      this.#sourceNode.connect(this.#gainNode);
      this.#gainNode.connect(this.#audioContext.destination);

      MEDIA_SOURCE_MAP.set(this.#media, {
        audioContext: this.#audioContext,
        sourceNode: this.#sourceNode,
        gainNode: this.#gainNode
      });

      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[AudioEngine] Web Audio API initialization skipped or failed:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  async #resumeAudioContextIfNeeded() {
    if (this.#audioContext && this.#audioContext.state === 'suspended') {
      try {
        await this.#audioContext.resume();
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn('[AudioEngine] Could not resume AudioContext:', error);
      }
    }
  }

  // ==================== STATE -> MEDIA SYNCHRONIZATION ====================

  #bindStateSubscriptions() {
    if (!this.#state || typeof this.#state.subscribe !== 'function') {
      return;
    }

    this.#unsubscribers.push(
      this.#state.subscribe('filePath', (nextPath) => {
        if (!this.#isUpdatingFromMedia) {
          this.#applyFilePath(nextPath);
        }
      }),

      this.#state.subscribe('isPlaying', (isPlaying) => {
        if (!this.#isUpdatingFromMedia) {
          this.#applyPlayState(isPlaying);
        }
      }),

      this.#state.subscribe('volume', (volume) => {
        if (!this.#isUpdatingFromMedia) {
          this.#applyVolumeAndMute(volume, this.#state.muted);
        }
      }),

      this.#state.subscribe('muted', (muted) => {
        if (!this.#isUpdatingFromMedia) {
          this.#applyVolumeAndMute(this.#state.volume, muted);
        }
      }),

      this.#state.subscribe('position', (position) => {
        if (!this.#isUpdatingFromMedia) {
          this.#applyPosition(position);
        }
      }),

      this.#state.subscribe('playbackSpeed', (speed) => {
        if (!this.#isUpdatingFromMedia) {
          this.#applyPlaybackSpeed(speed);
        }
      })
    );
  }

  #syncMediaFromCurrentState() {
    if (!this.#media || !this.#state) {
      return;
    }

    const snapshot = this.#state.getState();
    this.#applyVolumeAndMute(snapshot.volume, snapshot.muted);
    this.#applyPlaybackSpeed(snapshot.playbackSpeed);

    if (snapshot.filePath) {
      this.#applyFilePath(snapshot.filePath);
    }
    if (snapshot.position > 0) {
      this.#applyPosition(snapshot.position);
    }
    if (snapshot.isPlaying) {
      this.#applyPlayState(true);
    }
  }

  #applyFilePath(filePath) {
    if (!this.#media) {
      return;
    }

    this.#isApplyingState = true;
    try {
      if (!filePath) {
        this.#media.removeAttribute?.('src');
        this.#media.src = '';
        if (typeof this.#media.load === 'function') {
          this.#media.load();
        }
        return;
      }

      if (this.#media.src !== filePath) {
        this.#media.src = filePath;
        if (typeof this.#media.load === 'function') {
          this.#media.load();
        }
      }
    } finally {
      this.#isApplyingState = false;
    }
  }

  async #applyPlayState(shouldPlay) {
    if (!this.#media) {
      return;
    }

    this.#isApplyingState = true;
    try {
      if (shouldPlay) {
        await this.#resumeAudioContextIfNeeded();
        if (this.#media.paused && typeof this.#media.play === 'function') {
          const playPromise = this.#media.play();
          if (playPromise && typeof playPromise.catch === 'function') {
            await playPromise.catch((err) => {
              console.warn('[AudioEngine] Playback start prevented or interrupted:', err);
              this.#updateStateFromMedia({ isPlaying: false });
            });
          }
        }
      } else if (!this.#media.paused && typeof this.#media.pause === 'function') {
        this.#media.pause();
      }
    } finally {
      this.#isApplyingState = false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Applies volume (0%..200%) and mute state to the HTML5 MediaElement and Web Audio GainNode.
   * - 0%..100%: Native HTMLMediaElement.volume (0.0..1.0) with GainNode at 1.0
   * - 101%..200%: Native HTMLMediaElement.volume at 1.0 with Web Audio GainNode at 1.01..2.0
   */
  #applyVolumeAndMute(volumePercent, isMuted) {
    if (!this.#media) {
      return;
    }

    const clampedVolume = clamp(volumePercent, VOLUME_MIN, VOLUME_MAX, 100);
    const muted = Boolean(isMuted) || clampedVolume === 0;

    this.#isApplyingState = true;
    try {
      this.#media.muted = muted;

      if (muted) {
        this.#media.volume = 0;
        if (this.#gainNode) {
          this.#setGainValue(0);
        }
        return;
      }

      // Initialize Web Audio graph when boosting above 100% or if already active
      if (clampedVolume > 100 && !this.#gainNode) {
        this.#ensureAudioGraph();
      }

      if (this.#gainNode) {
        this.#resumeAudioContextIfNeeded();
        if (clampedVolume <= 100) {
          this.#media.volume = clampedVolume / 100;
          this.#setGainValue(1.0);
        } else {
          this.#media.volume = 1.0;
          this.#setGainValue(clampedVolume / 100);
        }
      } else {
        // Fallback when Web Audio API is unavailable: clamp native element volume to 1.0
        this.#media.volume = Math.min(1.0, Math.max(0.0, clampedVolume / 100));
      }
    } finally {
      this.#isApplyingState = false;
    }
  }

  #setGainValue(gainFactor) {
    if (!this.#gainNode) {
      return;
    }

    const safeGain = Math.max(0, Math.min(VOLUME_MAX / 100, Number(gainFactor) || 0));
    const currentTime = this.#audioContext ? this.#audioContext.currentTime : 0;

    if (
      this.#audioContext &&
      typeof this.#gainNode.gain.setTargetAtTime === 'function' &&
      currentTime > 0
    ) {
      this.#gainNode.gain.setTargetAtTime(safeGain, currentTime, 0.015);
    } else {
      this.#gainNode.gain.value = safeGain;
    }
  }

  #applyPosition(targetSeconds) {
    if (!this.#media) {
      return;
    }

    const safeTarget = Math.max(0, Number(targetSeconds) || 0);
    const currentMediaTime = Number(this.#media.currentTime) || 0;

    // Only seek the media element if the difference exceeds the tolerance threshold
    // to prevent feedback loops during normal playback timeupdate events.
    if (Math.abs(currentMediaTime - safeTarget) <= SEEK_TOLERANCE_SECONDS) {
      return;
    }

    this.#isApplyingState = true;
    try {
      this.#media.currentTime = safeTarget;
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[AudioEngine] Seek failed:', error);
    } finally {
      this.#isApplyingState = false;
    }
  }

  #applyPlaybackSpeed(speed) {
    if (!this.#media) {
      return;
    }

    const clampedSpeed = clamp(speed, SPEED_MIN, SPEED_MAX, 1.0);
    this.#isApplyingState = true;
    try {
      this.#media.playbackRate = clampedSpeed;
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[AudioEngine] Setting playbackRate failed:', error);
    } finally {
      this.#isApplyingState = false;
    }
  }

  // ==================== MEDIA -> STATE SYNCHRONIZATION ====================

  #attachDomListeners() {
    if (!this.#media || typeof this.#media.addEventListener !== 'function') {
      return;
    }

    const register = (event, handler) => {
      this.#media.addEventListener(event, handler);
      this.#domListeners.push({ event, handler });
    };

    register('play', () => {
      this.#resumeAudioContextIfNeeded();
      if (!this.#isApplyingState) {
        this.#updateStateFromMedia({ isPlaying: true });
      }
    });

    register('pause', () => {
      if (!this.#isApplyingState) {
        this.#updateStateFromMedia({ isPlaying: false });
      }
    });

    register('ended', () => {
      this.#updateStateFromMedia({ isPlaying: false });
    });

    register('timeupdate', () => {
      if (!this.#isApplyingState && this.#media) {
        const currentTime = Number(this.#media.currentTime);
        if (Number.isFinite(currentTime) && currentTime >= 0) {
          this.#updateStateFromMedia({ position: currentTime });
        }
      }
    });

    register('loadedmetadata', () => {
      if (!this.#media) {
        return;
      }
      const duration = Number(this.#media.duration);
      if (Number.isFinite(duration) && duration >= 0) {
        this.#updateStateFromMedia({ duration });
      }
      // Re-apply desired playbackRate & volume after media load resets them
      this.#applyPlaybackSpeed(this.#state.playbackSpeed);
      this.#applyVolumeAndMute(this.#state.volume, this.#state.muted);
    });

    register('durationchange', () => {
      if (!this.#media) {
        return;
      }
      const duration = Number(this.#media.duration);
      if (Number.isFinite(duration) && duration >= 0) {
        this.#updateStateFromMedia({ duration });
      }
    });

    register('ratechange', () => {
      if (!this.#isApplyingState && this.#media) {
        const rate = Number(this.#media.playbackRate);
        if (Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) {
          this.#updateStateFromMedia({ playbackSpeed: rate });
        }
      }
    });
  }

  #updateStateFromMedia(patch) {
    if (!this.#state) {
      return;
    }

    this.#isUpdatingFromMedia = true;
    try {
      this.#state.setState(patch);
    } finally {
      this.#isUpdatingFromMedia = false;
    }
  }

  // ==================== PUBLIC CONTROL API ====================

  /**
   * Loads a media file path or URL and updates the central state.
   * @param {string} filePath
   */
  load(filePath) {
    this.#state.setFilePath(filePath, true);
    this.#applyFilePath(this.#state.filePath);
  }

  /**
   * Starts playback.
   */
  async play() {
    this.#state.play();
    await this.#applyPlayState(true);
  }

  /**
   * Pauses playback.
   */
  pause() {
    this.#state.pause();
    this.#applyPlayState(false);
  }

  /**
   * Toggles between play and pause.
   */
  async togglePlay() {
    if (this.#state.isPlaying) {
      this.pause();
    } else {
      await this.play();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Seeks to an absolute position in seconds.
   * @param {number} positionSeconds
   */
  seek(positionSeconds) {
    const target = Math.max(0, Number(positionSeconds) || 0);
    this.#state.setPosition(target);
    if (this.#media) {
      this.#isApplyingState = true;
      try {
        this.#media.currentTime = this.#state.position;
      } finally {
        this.#isApplyingState = false;
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Seeks relative to the current playback position by `deltaSeconds`.
   * @param {number} deltaSeconds
   */
  seekRelative(deltaSeconds) {
    const current = this.#media && Number.isFinite(this.#media.currentTime)
      ? this.#media.currentTime
      : this.#state.position;
    this.seek(Math.max(0, current + (Number(deltaSeconds) || 0)));
  }

  /**
   * Sets the playback volume in percent (0% to 200% VLC Cone Boost).
   * @param {number} volumePercent
   */
  setVolume(volumePercent) {
    this.#state.setVolume(volumePercent);
    this.#applyVolumeAndMute(this.#state.volume, this.#state.muted);
  }

  /**
   * Adjusts the volume by a relative percentage delta (e.g., +5 or -5).
   * @param {number} deltaPercent
   */
  adjustVolume(deltaPercent) {
    this.#state.adjustVolume(deltaPercent);
    this.#applyVolumeAndMute(this.#state.volume, this.#state.muted);
  }

  /**
   * Returns the current volume percentage (0..200).
   * @returns {number}
   */
  getVolume() {
    return this.#state.volume;
  }

  /**
   * Returns the effective linear gain factor (0.0 to 2.0).
   * @returns {number}
   */
  getEffectiveGain() {
    if (this.#state.muted || this.#state.volume === 0) {
      return 0;
    }
    return this.#state.volume / 100;
  }

  /**
   * Sets or unsets mute state.
   * @param {boolean} muted
   */
  setMuted(muted) {
    this.#state.setMuted(muted);
    this.#applyVolumeAndMute(this.#state.volume, this.#state.muted);
  }

  /**
   * Toggles mute state.
   */
  toggleMute() {
    this.#state.toggleMute();
    this.#applyVolumeAndMute(this.#state.volume, this.#state.muted);
  }

  /**
   * Sets the playback speed (0.25x to 4.0x).
   * @param {number} speed
   */
  setPlaybackSpeed(speed) {
    this.#state.setPlaybackSpeed(speed);
    this.#applyPlaybackSpeed(this.#state.playbackSpeed);
  }

  /**
   * Cleans up all state subscriptions and DOM listeners.
   */
  destroy() {
    for (const unsubscribe of this.#unsubscribers) {
      if (typeof unsubscribe === 'function') {
        unsubscribe();
      }
    }
    this.#unsubscribers = [];
    this.detachMediaElement();
  }
}

export const audioEngine = new AudioEngine();
export default AudioEngine;
```

### Funktionsübersicht von [src/thumbnails.js](file:///C:/Users/Schual/Desktop/VLCopyCAT/src/thumbnails.js)

1. **Unsichtbare Offscreen-Video- & Canvas-Pipeline ([`#ensureOffscreenElements()`](file:///C:/Users/Schual/Desktop/VLCopyCAT/src/thumbnails.js#L131-L176) & [`captureFrameFromElement()`](file:///C:/Users/Schual/Desktop/VLCopyCAT/src/thumbnails.js#L455-L511)):**
   * Nutzt ein eigenes, unsichtbares `<video>`-Element (`muted`, `preload="metadata"`) sowie ein `<canvas>`, sodass das Hauptvideo beim Hovern über die Zeitleiste niemals unterbrochen oder verstellt wird.
   * Berechnet das Seitenverhältnis (`videoWidth / videoHeight`) automatisch innerhalb von `maxWidth` × `maxHeight` (Standard: `240×135`) und exportiert wahlweise als **Data-URL** (`canvas.toDataURL`) oder **Blob-URL** (`canvas.toBlob` + `URL.createObjectURL`).
2. **LRU-Cache & Zeitstempel-Quantisierung ([`quantizeTime()`](file:///C:/Users/Schual/Desktop/VLCopyCAT/src/thumbnails.js#L185-L190), [`getCachedThumbnail()`](file:///C:/Users/Schual/Desktop/VLCopyCAT/src/thumbnails.js#L202-L220), [`#storeInCache()`](file:///C:/Users/Schual/Desktop/VLCopyCAT/src/thumbnails.js#L222-L241)):**
   * Rundet Hover-Zeiten auf konfigurierbare Zeitfenster (`bucketSeconds = 1.0s`), damit leichtes Bewegen der Maus sofort aus dem Cache bedient wird.
   * Implementiert einen echten **LRU-Cache** auf Basis einer `Map` (aktualisiert die Zugriffsreihenfolge bei jedem Treffer, entfernt bei Überschreiten von `maxCacheSize` den ältesten Eintrag und gibt eventuelle `blob:`-URLs per `URL.revokeObjectURL` sauber frei).
3. **Request-Coalescing („Latest Wins“) & Fehlertoleranz ([`getThumbnail()`](file:///C:/Users/Schual/Desktop/VLCopyCAT/src/thumbnails.js#L283-L333)):**
   * Überspringt bei schnellem Scrubben veraltete Zwischen-Anfragen zugunsten der aktuellsten Mausposition und schützt Seeks mit einem Timeout (`seekTimeoutMs = 2500ms`), sodass defekte Frames niemals die Warteschlange blockieren.

### Vollständiger Code ([src/thumbnails.js](file:///C:/Users/Schual/Desktop/VLCopyCAT/src/thumbnails.js))

```javascript
// CopyCat Media Player (VLCopyCat) — Timeline Thumbnail Generator & LRU Cache (ES6)
// Renders video frames at arbitrary timestamps using a hidden video + canvas pipeline
// with LRU caching, timestamp quantization, and request coalescing for zero-stutter scrubbing.

import { playerState } from './state.js';

const DEFAULT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  maxWidth: 240,
  maxHeight: 135,
  quality: 0.78,
  mimeType: 'image/jpeg',
  outputType: 'dataUrl',    // 'dataUrl' | 'blobUrl'
  bucketSeconds: 1.0,       // Quantize hover timestamps to 1s buckets for high cache hit rate
  maxCacheSize: 160,        // Maximum thumbnails kept in LRU cache
  seekTimeoutMs: 2500,      // Timeout per frame seek operation
  syncWithState: true       // Automatically listen to playerState.filePath changes
});

function clamp(value, min, max, fallback) {
  const num = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) {
    return fallback;
  }
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, num));
}

export class ThumbnailManager {
  #options;
  #sourceUrl = null;
  #probeVideo = null;
  #canvas = null;
  #ctx = null;
  #cache = new Map();
  #inFlightByKey = new Map();
  #pendingTask = null;
  #isProcessing = false;
  #probeReady = false;
  #probeError = false;
  #unsubscribeState = null;

  /**
   * @param {object} [options={}]
   * @param {number} [options.maxWidth=240]
   * @param {number} [options.maxHeight=135]
   * @param {number} [options.quality=0.78]
   * @param {'image/jpeg'|'image/png'|'image/webp'} [options.mimeType='image/jpeg']
   * @param {'dataUrl'|'blobUrl'} [options.outputType='dataUrl']
   * @param {number} [options.bucketSeconds=1.0]
   * @param {number} [options.maxCacheSize=160]
   * @param {number} [options.seekTimeoutMs=2500]
   * @param {boolean} [options.syncWithState=true]
   * @param {import('./state.js').PlayerState} [stateManager=playerState]
   */
  constructor(options = {}, stateManager = playerState) {
    this.#options = {
      ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS,
      ...(options && typeof options === 'object' ? options : {})
    };

    this.#options.maxWidth = Math.max(32, Math.round(Number(this.#options.maxWidth) || 240));
    this.#options.maxHeight = Math.max(18, Math.round(Number(this.#options.maxHeight) || 135));
    this.#options.quality = clamp(this.#options.quality, 0.1, 1.0, 0.78);
    this.#options.bucketSeconds = clamp(this.#options.bucketSeconds, 0.1, 30.0, 1.0);
    this.#options.maxCacheSize = Math.max(10, Math.round(Number(this.#options.maxCacheSize) || 160));
    this.#options.seekTimeoutMs = Math.max(300, Math.round(Number(this.#options.seekTimeoutMs) || 2500));

    if (this.#options.syncWithState && stateManager && typeof stateManager.subscribe === 'function') {
      if (stateManager.filePath) {
        this.setSource(stateManager.filePath);
      }
      this.#unsubscribeState = stateManager.subscribe('filePath', (nextFilePath) => {
        this.setSource(nextFilePath);
      });
    }
  }

  // ==================== SOURCE & OFFSCREEN DOM SETUP ====================

  /**
   * Binds a media source URL/filePath for thumbnail extraction and resets the cache if changed.
   * @param {string|HTMLMediaElement|null} source
   * @returns {this}
   */
  setSource(source) {
    let resolvedUrl = null;

    if (typeof source === 'string' && source.trim().length > 0) {
      resolvedUrl = source.trim();
    } else if (source && typeof source === 'object' && typeof source.src === 'string') {
      resolvedUrl = source.currentSrc || source.src || null;
    }

    if (resolvedUrl === this.#sourceUrl) {
      return this;
    }

    this.#sourceUrl = resolvedUrl;
    this.#probeReady = false;
    this.#probeError = false;
    this.#pendingTask = null;
    this.clearCache();

    if (this.#probeVideo) {
      try {
        this.#probeVideo.pause?.();
        if (resolvedUrl) {
          this.#probeVideo.src = resolvedUrl;
          this.#probeVideo.load?.();
        } else {
          this.#probeVideo.removeAttribute?.('src');
          this.#probeVideo.src = '';
          this.#probeVideo.load?.();
        }
      } catch {
        this.#probeError = true;
      }
    }

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Alias to bind the source of an existing HTMLVideoElement.
   * @param {HTMLMediaElement} mediaElement
   * @returns {this}
   */
  attachMediaElement(mediaElement) {
    if (!mediaElement || typeof mediaElement !== 'object') {
      return this;
    }
    return this.setSource(mediaElement.currentSrc || mediaElement.src || null);
  }

  /**
   * Returns the currently active media source URL.
   * @returns {string|null}
   */
  get source() {
    return this.#sourceUrl;
  }

  #ensureOffscreenElements() {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined' || typeof document.createElement !== 'function') {
      return false;
    }

    if (!this.#canvas) {
      this.#canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      this.#canvas.width = this.#options.maxWidth;
      this.#canvas.height = this.#options.maxHeight;
      this.#ctx = this.#canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false, willReadFrequently: false });
    }

    if (!this.#probeVideo) {
      const video = document.createElement('video');
      video.preload = 'metadata';
      video.muted = true;
      video.playsInline = true;
      video.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      video.style.position = 'fixed';
      video.style.left = '-9999px';
      video.style.top = '-9999px';
      video.style.width = '1px';
      video.style.height = '1px';
      video.style.opacity = '0';
      video.style.pointerEvents = 'none';

      video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
        this.#probeReady = true;
        this.#probeError = false;
      });

      video.addEventListener('error', () => {
        this.#probeError = true;
        this.#probeReady = false;
      });

      this.#probeVideo = video;

      if (this.#sourceUrl) {
        this.#probeVideo.src = this.#sourceUrl;
        this.#probeVideo.load?.();
      }
    }

    return Boolean(this.#canvas && this.#ctx && this.#probeVideo);
  }

  // ==================== TIMESTAMP QUANTIZATION & LRU CACHE ====================

  /**
   * Quantizes a floating-point timestamp into a stable bucket key for high cache reuse.
   * @param {number} timeSeconds
   * @returns {number} Quantized time in seconds.
   */
  quantizeTime(timeSeconds) {
    const safeTime = Math.max(0, Number(timeSeconds) || 0);
    const bucket = this.#options.bucketSeconds;
    const quantized = Math.round(safeTime / bucket) * bucket;
    return Math.round(quantized * 1000) / 1000;
  }

  #makeCacheKey(quantizedTime) {
    return `${this.#sourceUrl || '__none__'}@${quantizedTime.toFixed(3)}`;
  }

  /**
   * Synchronously returns a cached thumbnail URL for the given timestamp if available.
   * Automatically promotes the entry in the LRU cache.
   * @param {number} timeSeconds
   * @returns {string|null}
   */
  getCachedThumbnail(timeSeconds) {
    if (!this.#sourceUrl || !Number.isFinite(Number(timeSeconds))) {
      return null;
    }

    const qTime = this.quantizeTime(timeSeconds);
    const key = this.#makeCacheKey(qTime);

    if (!this.#cache.has(key)) {
      return null;
    }

    // Refresh LRU order (delete and re-insert at the end of Map)
    const cachedUrl = this.#cache.get(key);
    this.#cache.delete(key);
    this.#cache.set(key, cachedUrl);

    return cachedUrl;
  }

  #storeInCache(key, thumbnailUrl) {
    if (!thumbnailUrl) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.#cache.has(key)) {
      this.#cache.delete(key);
    } else if (this.#cache.size >= this.#options.maxCacheSize) {
      // Evict least-recently-used entry (first item in Map)
      const oldestKey = this.#cache.keys().next().value;
      if (oldestKey !== undefined) {
        const oldestUrl = this.#cache.get(oldestKey);
        this.#revokeIfBlobUrl(oldestUrl);
        this.#cache.delete(oldestKey);
      }
    }

    this.#cache.set(key, thumbnailUrl);
  }

  #revokeIfBlobUrl(url) {
    if (typeof url === 'string' && url.startsWith('blob:') && typeof URL !== 'undefined' && typeof URL.revokeObjectURL === 'function') {
      try {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      } catch {
        // Ignore revoke errors
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Clears all cached thumbnails and revokes any generated Object URLs.
   */
  clearCache() {
    for (const url of this.#cache.values()) {
      this.#revokeIfBlobUrl(url);
    }
    this.#cache.clear();
    this.#inFlightByKey.clear();
  }

  /**
   * Returns current cache metrics.
   * @returns {{size: number, maxSize: number, bucketSeconds: number, source: string|null}}
   */
  getCacheStats() {
    return {
      size: this.#cache.size,
      maxSize: this.#options.maxCacheSize,
      bucketSeconds: this.#options.bucketSeconds,
      source: this.#sourceUrl
    };
  }

  // ==================== THUMBNAIL GENERATION & COALESCING QUEUE ====================

  /**
   * Retrieves or generates a thumbnail Data-URL or Blob-URL for `timeSeconds`.
   * Resolves immediately on LRU cache hits; coalesces rapid scrub requests otherwise.
   * Never throws on decode/seek failures (resolves to `null`).
   * @param {number} timeSeconds
   * @param {object} [overrideOptions={}]
   * @returns {Promise<string|null>}
   */
  async getThumbnail(timeSeconds, overrideOptions = {}) {
    try {
      const numTime = Number(timeSeconds);
      if (!this.#sourceUrl || !Number.isFinite(numTime) || numTime < 0) {
        return null;
      }

      const cached = this.getCachedThumbnail(numTime);
      if (cached) {
        return cached;
      }

      if (!this.#ensureOffscreenElements() || this.#probeError) {
        return null;
      }

      const qTime = this.quantizeTime(numTime);
      const key = this.#makeCacheKey(qTime);

      if (this.#inFlightByKey.has(key)) {
        return this.#inFlightByKey.get(key);
      }

      const taskPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {
        // If another pending task wasn't started yet, resolve it with null so callers don't hang,
        // prioritizing the newest scrub timestamp ("latest wins").
        if (this.#pendingTask && this.#pendingTask.key !== key) {
          const superseded = this.#pendingTask;
          this.#inFlightByKey.delete(superseded.key);
          superseded.resolve(null);
        }

        this.#pendingTask = {
          key,
          timeSeconds: qTime,
          options: { ...this.#options, ...overrideOptions },
          resolve
        };

        this.#processNextInQueue();
      });

      this.#inFlightByKey.set(key, taskPromise);
      return taskPromise;
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[ThumbnailManager] Unexpected error in getThumbnail:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Alias for `getThumbnail(timeSeconds, overrideOptions)`.
   * @param {number} timeSeconds
   * @param {object} [overrideOptions={}]
   * @returns {Promise<string|null>}
   */
  async getThumbnailAt(timeSeconds, overrideOptions = {}) {
    return this.getThumbnail(timeSeconds, overrideOptions);
  }

  async #processNextInQueue() {
    if (this.#isProcessing || !this.#pendingTask) {
      return;
    }

    this.#isProcessing = true;

    while (this.#pendingTask) {
      const currentTask = this.#pendingTask;
      this.#pendingTask = null;

      let resultUrl = null;
      try {
        if (this.#cache.has(currentTask.key)) {
          resultUrl = this.#cache.get(currentTask.key);
        } else {
          resultUrl = await this.#seekAndCaptureFrame(currentTask.timeSeconds, currentTask.options);
          if (resultUrl) {
            this.#storeInCache(currentTask.key, resultUrl);
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn('[ThumbnailManager] Frame capture failed:', error);
        resultUrl = null;
      } finally {
        this.#inFlightByKey.delete(currentTask.key);
        currentTask.resolve(resultUrl);
      }
    }

    this.#isProcessing = false;
  }

  async #seekAndCaptureFrame(targetSeconds, renderOptions) {
    const video = this.#probeVideo;
    if (!video || this.#probeError || !this.#sourceUrl) {
      return null;
    }

    const ready = await this.#waitForMetadata(video, renderOptions.seekTimeoutMs);
    if (!ready) {
      return null;
    }

    const duration = Number(video.duration);
    const clampedTarget = (Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0)
      ? Math.min(Math.max(0, targetSeconds), Math.max(0, duration - 0.05))
      : Math.max(0, targetSeconds);

    const seekSucceeded = await this.#seekVideoTo(video, clampedTarget, renderOptions.seekTimeoutMs);
    if (!seekSucceeded) {
      return null;
    }

    return this.captureFrameFromElement(video, renderOptions);
  }

  #waitForMetadata(video, timeoutMs) {
    if (this.#probeReady || (video.readyState >= 1 && video.videoWidth > 0)) {
      this.#probeReady = true;
      return Promise.resolve(true);
    }

    if (this.#probeError) {
      return Promise.resolve(false);
    }

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let settled = false;
      let timerId = null;

      const cleanup = () => {
        if (timerId !== null) {
          clearTimeout(timerId);
        }
        video.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onLoaded);
        video.removeEventListener('error', onError);
      };

      const finish = (success) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        cleanup();
        resolve(success);
      };

      const onLoaded = () => {
        this.#probeReady = true;
        finish(video.videoWidth > 0 && video.videoHeight > 0);
      };

      const onError = () => {
        this.#probeError = true;
        finish(false);
      };

      timerId = setTimeout(() => finish(false), timeoutMs);
      video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onLoaded, { once: true });
      video.addEventListener('error', onError, { once: true });
    });
  }

  #seekVideoTo(video, targetSeconds, timeoutMs) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (Math.abs((Number(video.currentTime) || 0) - targetSeconds) < 0.02 && video.readyState >= 2) {
        resolve(true);
        return;
      }

      let settled = false;
      let timerId = null;

      const cleanup = () => {
        if (timerId !== null) {
          clearTimeout(timerId);
        }
        video.removeEventListener('seeked', onSeeked);
        video.removeEventListener('error', onError);
      };

      const finish = (success) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        cleanup();
        resolve(success);
      };

      const onSeeked = () => finish(true);
      const onError = () => finish(false);

      timerId = setTimeout(() => finish(false), timeoutMs);
      video.addEventListener('seeked', onSeeked, { once: true });
      video.addEventListener('error', onError, { once: true });

      try {
        video.currentTime = targetSeconds;
      } catch {
        finish(false);
      }
    });
  }

  // ==================== CANVAS RENDERING ====================

  /**
   * Renders the current visual frame of any HTMLVideoElement onto an offscreen canvas
   * and exports it as a Data-URL or Blob-URL.
   * @param {HTMLVideoElement} videoElement
   * @param {object} [renderOptions={}]
   * @returns {Promise<string|null>}
   */
  async captureFrameFromElement(videoElement, renderOptions = {}) {
    try {
      if (!videoElement || !this.#ensureOffscreenElements()) {
        return null;
      }

      const srcWidth = Number(videoElement.videoWidth) || 0;
      const srcHeight = Number(videoElement.videoHeight) || 0;
      if (srcWidth <= 0 || srcHeight <= 0) {
        return null;
      }

      const maxWidth = Number(renderOptions.maxWidth) || this.#options.maxWidth;
      const maxHeight = Number(renderOptions.maxHeight) || this.#options.maxHeight;
      const mimeType = renderOptions.mimeType || this.#options.mimeType;
      const quality = clamp(renderOptions.quality ?? this.#options.quality, 0.1, 1.0, 0.78);
      const outputType = renderOptions.outputType || this.#options.outputType;

      // Preserve source video aspect ratio within maxWidth x maxHeight bounds
      const scale = Math.min(maxWidth / srcWidth, maxHeight / srcHeight, 1);
      const targetWidth = Math.max(1, Math.round(srcWidth * scale));
      const targetHeight = Math.max(1, Math.round(srcHeight * scale));

      if (this.#canvas.width !== targetWidth || this.#canvas.height !== targetHeight) {
        this.#canvas.width = targetWidth;
        this.#canvas.height = targetHeight;
      }

      this.#ctx.clearRect(0, 0, targetWidth, targetHeight);
      this.#ctx.drawImage(videoElement, 0, 0, targetWidth, targetHeight);

      if (outputType === 'blobUrl' && typeof this.#canvas.toBlob === 'function' && typeof URL !== 'undefined') {
        return await new Promise((resolve) => {
          this.#canvas.toBlob(
            (blob) => {
              if (!blob) {
                resolve(null);
                return;
              }
              try {
                resolve(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
              } catch {
                resolve(null);
              }
            },
            mimeType,
            quality
          );
        });
      }

      return this.#canvas.toDataURL(mimeType, quality);
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[ThumbnailManager] Canvas frame draw/export failed:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Pre-generates thumbnails across a time range in the background to warm the LRU cache.
   * @param {number} startSeconds
   * @param {number} endSeconds
   * @param {number} [stepSeconds=5]
   * @returns {Promise<number>} Number of thumbnails successfully cached.
   */
  async preloadRange(startSeconds, endSeconds, stepSeconds = 5) {
    const start = Math.max(0, Number(startSeconds) || 0);
    const end = Math.max(start, Number(endSeconds) || 0);
    const step = Math.max(0.5, Number(stepSeconds) || 5);

    let generatedCount = 0;
    for (let t = start; t <= end; t += step) {
      if (!this.#sourceUrl || this.#probeError) {
        break;
      }
      const url = await this.getThumbnail(t);
      if (url) {
        generatedCount++;
      }
    }
    return generatedCount;
  }

  /**
   * Releases all resources, revokes cached Blob URLs, and detaches offscreen DOM elements.
   */
  destroy() {
    if (typeof this.#unsubscribeState === 'function') {
      this.#unsubscribeState();
      this.#unsubscribeState = null;
    }

    this.#pendingTask = null;
    this.clearCache();

    if (this.#probeVideo) {
      try {
        this.#probeVideo.pause?.();
        this.#probeVideo.removeAttribute?.('src');
        this.#probeVideo.src = '';
        this.#probeVideo.load?.();
      } catch {
        // Ignore cleanup errors
      }
      this.#probeVideo = null;
    }

    this.#canvas = null;
    this.#ctx = null;
    this.#sourceUrl = null;
  }
}

export const thumbnailManager = new ThumbnailManager();
export default ThumbnailManager;
```

### Vollständiger Code ([src/playlist.js](file:///C:/Users/Schual/Desktop/VLCopyCAT/src/playlist.js))

```javascript
// CopyCat Media Player (VLCopyCat) — Playlist Manager Module (ES6)
// Manages media queues, navigation, repeat ('off' | 'all' | 'one'), shuffle (Fisher-Yates),
// instant search/filtering, and bidirectional synchronization with PlayerState (src/state.js).

import { playerState } from './state.js';

export const REPEAT_MODES = Object.freeze(['off', 'all', 'one']);

let itemCounter = 0;

function extractTitleFromPath(filePath) {
  if (typeof filePath !== 'string' || filePath.trim().length === 0) {
    return 'Unbekanntes Medium';
  }
  const normalized = filePath.trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const segments = normalized.split('/');
  const fileName = segments[segments.length - 1] || normalized;
  const lastDot = fileName.lastIndexOf('.');
  return lastDot > 0 ? fileName.slice(0, lastDot) : fileName;
}

function normalizeMediaItem(rawInput) {
  if (typeof rawInput === 'string') {
    const trimmed = rawInput.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      return null;
    }
    itemCounter += 1;
    return {
      id: `item_${Date.now()}_${itemCounter}`,
      filePath: trimmed,
      title: extractTitleFromPath(trimmed),
      duration: 0,
      subtitlePath: null,
      metadata: {}
    };
  }

  if (!rawInput || typeof rawInput !== 'object') {
    return null;
  }

  const rawPath = rawInput.filePath || rawInput.path || rawInput.src || rawInput.url;
  if (typeof rawPath !== 'string' || rawPath.trim().length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const filePath = rawPath.trim();
  const title = (typeof rawInput.title === 'string' && rawInput.title.trim().length > 0)
    ? rawInput.title.trim()
    : (typeof rawInput.name === 'string' && rawInput.name.trim().length > 0)
      ? rawInput.name.trim()
      : extractTitleFromPath(filePath);

  const durationNum = Number(rawInput.duration);
  const duration = (Number.isFinite(durationNum) && durationNum >= 0) ? durationNum : 0;

  const subtitlePath = (typeof rawInput.subtitlePath === 'string' && rawInput.subtitlePath.trim().length > 0)
    ? rawInput.subtitlePath.trim()
    : null;

  itemCounter += 1;
  return {
    id: (typeof rawInput.id === 'string' && rawInput.id.trim().length > 0)
      ? rawInput.id.trim()
      : `item_${Date.now()}_${itemCounter}`,
    filePath,
    title,
    duration,
    subtitlePath,
    metadata: (rawInput.metadata && typeof rawInput.metadata === 'object')
      ? { ...rawInput.metadata }
      : {}
  };
}

export class PlaylistManager {
  #items = [];
  #currentIndex = -1;
  #repeat = 'off';       // 'off' | 'all' | 'one'
  #shuffle = false;      // boolean
  #shuffleOrder = [];    // Array of item indices in shuffled play order
  #shuffleCursor = -1;   // Current position inside #shuffleOrder
  #state = null;
  #mediaElement = null;
  #mediaEndedHandler = null;
  #unsubscribers = [];
  #listeners = new Map();
  #isSyncingToState = false;

  /**
   * @param {import('./state.js').PlayerState} [stateManager=playerState]
   * @param {object} [options={}]
   * @param {Array<string|object>} [options.items=[]]
   * @param {'off'|'all'|'one'} [options.repeat='off']
   * @param {boolean} [options.shuffle=false]
   * @param {number} [options.restartThresholdSec=3]
   */
  constructor(stateManager = playerState, options = {}) {
    this.#state = stateManager || playerState;
    this.restartThresholdSec = Number.isFinite(Number(options.restartThresholdSec))
      ? Math.max(0, Number(options.restartThresholdSec))
      : 3;

    if (options.repeat && REPEAT_MODES.includes(options.repeat)) {
      this.#repeat = options.repeat;
    }
    if (typeof options.shuffle === 'boolean') {
      this.#shuffle = options.shuffle;
    }

    this.#bindStateManager();

    if (Array.isArray(options.items) && options.items.length > 0) {
      this.add(options.items, { autoSelect: false });
    }
  }

  // ==================== STATEMANAGER & MEDIA COUPLING ====================

  #bindStateManager() {
    if (!this.#state || typeof this.#state.subscribe !== 'function') {
      return;
    }

    const handleEnded = () => {
      this.handleMediaEnded();
    };

    this.#unsubscribers.push(
      this.#state.subscribe('ended', handleEnded),

      this.#state.subscribe('duration', (newDuration) => {
        if (this.#currentIndex >= 0 && this.#currentIndex < this.#items.length && newDuration > 0) {
          this.#items[this.#currentIndex].duration = newDuration;
          this.#emit('change', this.getItems());
        }
      }),

      this.#state.subscribe('filePath', (nextFilePath) => {
        if (this.#isSyncingToState || !nextFilePath) {
          return;
        }
        const matchedIndex = this.#items.findIndex((item) => item.filePath === nextFilePath);
        if (matchedIndex !== -1 && matchedIndex !== this.#currentIndex) {
          this.#currentIndex = matchedIndex;
          this.#syncShuffleCursorToCurrentIndex();
          this.#emit('trackChange', this.currentItem, this.#currentIndex);
        }
      })
    );
  }

  /**
   * Optionally binds directly to an HTMLMediaElement's `ended` event as a fallback.
   * @param {HTMLMediaElement} mediaElement
   * @returns {this}
   */
  attachMediaElement(mediaElement) {
    this.detachMediaElement();
    if (mediaElement && typeof mediaElement.addEventListener === 'function') {
      this.#mediaElement = mediaElement;
      this.#mediaEndedHandler = () => this.handleMediaEnded();
      this.#mediaElement.addEventListener('ended', this.#mediaEndedHandler);
    }
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Detaches a directly bound HTMLMediaElement.
   */
  detachMediaElement() {
    if (this.#mediaElement && this.#mediaEndedHandler && typeof this.#mediaElement.removeEventListener === 'function') {
      this.#mediaElement.removeEventListener('ended', this.#mediaEndedHandler);
    }
    this.#mediaElement = null;
    this.#mediaEndedHandler = null;
  }

  /**
   * Triggered automatically when the current track finishes playing.
   * Advances according to `repeat` ('off' | 'all' | 'one') and `shuffle`.
   * @returns {object|null} The newly active item, or null if playback stopped.
   */
  handleMediaEnded() {
    if (this.#items.length === 0 || this.#currentIndex === -1) {
      return null;
    }

    if (this.#repeat === 'one') {
      const current = this.currentItem;
      this.#syncCurrentItemToState(current, { autoPlay: true, forceReload: true });
      this.#emit('trackChange', current, this.#currentIndex);
      return current;
    }

    return this.next({ fromEnded: true, autoPlay: true });
  }

  #syncCurrentItemToState(item, { autoPlay = true, forceReload = false } = {}) {
    if (!this.#state) {
      return;
    }

    this.#isSyncingToState = true;
    try {
      if (!item) {
        this.#state.setState({
          filePath: null,
          currentFile: null,
          isPlaying: false,
          position: 0,
          duration: 0
        });
        return;
      }

      if (forceReload && this.#state.filePath === item.filePath) {
        this.#state.setState({
          position: 0,
          isPlaying: Boolean(autoPlay)
        });
      } else {
        this.#state.setState({
          filePath: item.filePath,
          currentFile: item.filePath,
          position: 0,
          duration: item.duration || 0,
          isPlaying: Boolean(autoPlay)
        });
      }
    } finally {
      this.#isSyncingToState = false;
    }
  }

  // ==================== PLAYLIST MUTATION (ADD / REMOVE / CLEAR) ====================

  /**
   * Adds one or more media items to the playlist.
   * @param {string|object|Array<string|object>} itemOrItems
   * @param {object} [options={}]
   * @param {number} [options.index] - Optional insertion index.
   * @param {boolean} [options.autoSelect=false] - Automatically select the first added item if none is active.
   * @param {boolean} [options.autoPlay=false] - Start playback immediately if auto-selected.
   * @returns {Array<object>} Array of newly added normalized items.
   */
  add(itemOrItems, options = {}) {
    const rawList = Array.isArray(itemOrItems) ? itemOrItems : [itemOrItems];
    const added = [];

    for (const raw of rawList) {
      const normalized = normalizeMediaItem(raw);
      if (normalized) {
        added.push(normalized);
      }
    }

    if (added.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    const wasEmpty = this.#items.length === 0;
    const insertIndex = Number.isInteger(options.index)
      ? Math.max(0, Math.min(this.#items.length, options.index))
      : this.#items.length;

    this.#items.splice(insertIndex, 0, ...added);

    if (!wasEmpty && this.#currentIndex >= insertIndex) {
      this.#currentIndex += added.length;
    }

    this.#rebuildShuffleOrder();

    if (wasEmpty && options.autoSelect) {
      this.jumpTo(0, Boolean(options.autoPlay));
    } else {
      this.#emit('change', this.getItems());
    }

    return added.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
  }

  /**
   * Removes an item by its playlist index, item `id`, or `filePath`.
   * @param {number|string} indexOrIdentifier
   * @returns {object|null} The removed item, or null if not found.
   */
  remove(indexOrIdentifier) {
    let targetIndex = -1;

    if (typeof indexOrIdentifier === 'number' && Number.isInteger(indexOrIdentifier)) {
      if (indexOrIdentifier >= 0 && indexOrIdentifier < this.#items.length) {
        targetIndex = indexOrIdentifier;
      }
    } else if (typeof indexOrIdentifier === 'string') {
      targetIndex = this.#items.findIndex(
        (item) => item.id === indexOrIdentifier || item.filePath === indexOrIdentifier
      );
    }

    if (targetIndex === -1) {
      return null;
    }

    const [removed] = this.#items.splice(targetIndex, 1);
    const removedActiveTrack = targetIndex === this.#currentIndex;

    if (this.#items.length === 0) {
      this.#currentIndex = -1;
      this.#shuffleOrder = [];
      this.#shuffleCursor = -1;
      this.#syncCurrentItemToState(null, { autoPlay: false });
      this.#emit('trackChange', null, -1);
      this.#emit('change', []);
      return removed;
    }

    if (targetIndex < this.#currentIndex) {
      this.#currentIndex -= 1;
    } else if (removedActiveTrack) {
      const wasPlaying = Boolean(this.#state?.isPlaying);
      if (this.#currentIndex >= this.#items.length) {
        this.#currentIndex = this.#repeat === 'all' ? 0 : this.#items.length - 1;
      }
      this.#rebuildShuffleOrder();
      const nextActive = this.currentItem;
      this.#syncCurrentItemToState(nextActive, { autoPlay: wasPlaying });
      this.#emit('trackChange', nextActive, this.#currentIndex);
      this.#emit('change', this.getItems());
      return removed;
    }

    this.#rebuildShuffleOrder();
    this.#emit('change', this.getItems());
    return removed;
  }

  /**
   * Clears all items from the playlist and resets playback state.
   */
  clear() {
    this.#items = [];
    this.#currentIndex = -1;
    this.#shuffleOrder = [];
    this.#shuffleCursor = -1;

    this.#syncCurrentItemToState(null, { autoPlay: false });
    this.#emit('trackChange', null, -1);
    this.#emit('change', []);
  }

  // ==================== NAVIGATION (JUMP / NEXT / PREVIOUS) ====================

  /**
   * Jumps directly to the specified playlist index and updates the central PlayerState.
   * @param {number} index
   * @param {boolean} [autoPlay=true]
   * @returns {object|null} The selected media item, or null if index is out of bounds.
   */
  jumpTo(index, autoPlay = true) {
    const idx = Number(index);
    if (!Number.isInteger(idx) || idx < 0 || idx >= this.#items.length) {
      return null;
    }

    this.#currentIndex = idx;
    this.#syncShuffleCursorToCurrentIndex();

    const selected = this.currentItem;
    this.#syncCurrentItemToState(selected, { autoPlay, forceReload: true });
    this.#emit('trackChange', selected, this.#currentIndex);
    this.#emit('change', this.getItems());

    return selected;
  }

  /**
   * Advances to the next track in the playlist, respecting `shuffle` and `repeat` modes.
   * @param {object} [options={}]
   * @param {boolean} [options.fromEnded=false]
   * @param {boolean} [options.autoPlay=true]
   * @returns {object|null}
   */
  next(options = {}) {
    const len = this.#items.length;
    if (len === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    const fromEnded = Boolean(options.fromEnded);
    const autoPlay = options.autoPlay !== undefined ? Boolean(options.autoPlay) : true;

    if (fromEnded && this.#repeat === 'one' && this.#currentIndex !== -1) {
      return this.jumpTo(this.#currentIndex, autoPlay);
    }

    if (this.#currentIndex === -1) {
      const startIdx = this.#shuffle && this.#shuffleOrder.length > 0 ? this.#shuffleOrder[0] : 0;
      return this.jumpTo(startIdx, autoPlay);
    }

    if (this.#shuffle) {
      if (this.#shuffleOrder.length !== len) {
        this.#rebuildShuffleOrder();
      }
      const nextCursor = this.#shuffleCursor + 1;
      if (nextCursor < this.#shuffleOrder.length) {
        this.#shuffleCursor = nextCursor;
        return this.jumpTo(this.#shuffleOrder[this.#shuffleCursor], autoPlay);
      }

      if (this.#repeat === 'all' || this.#repeat === 'one') {
        this.#rebuildShuffleOrder({ avoidFirstIndex: this.#currentIndex });
        this.#shuffleCursor = 0;
        return this.jumpTo(this.#shuffleOrder[0], autoPlay);
      }

      this.#state?.pause?.();
      return null;
    }

    // Sequential mode
    const nextIndex = this.#currentIndex + 1;
    if (nextIndex < len) {
      return this.jumpTo(nextIndex, autoPlay);
    }

    if (this.#repeat === 'all' || this.#repeat === 'one') {
      return this.jumpTo(0, autoPlay);
    }

    this.#state?.pause?.();
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Steps to the previous track (or restarts the current track if position > `restartThresholdSec`).
   * @param {object} [options={}]
   * @param {boolean} [options.forcePrevious=false] - Always jump to previous item even if position > threshold.
   * @param {boolean} [options.autoPlay=true]
   * @returns {object|null}
   */
  previous(options = {}) {
    const len = this.#items.length;
    if (len === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    const autoPlay = options.autoPlay !== undefined ? Boolean(options.autoPlay) : true;
    const forcePrevious = Boolean(options.forcePrevious);

    if (this.#currentIndex === -1) {
      return this.jumpTo(0, autoPlay);
    }

    // If playback is past threshold (e.g. >3s), restart current track first
    const currentPos = Number(this.#state?.position) || 0;
    if (!forcePrevious && currentPos > this.restartThresholdSec) {
      this.#state?.setPosition?.(0);
      if (autoPlay) {
        this.#state?.play?.();
      }
      return this.currentItem;
    }

    if (this.#shuffle) {
      if (this.#shuffleOrder.length !== len) {
        this.#rebuildShuffleOrder();
      }
      const prevCursor = this.#shuffleCursor - 1;
      if (prevCursor >= 0) {
        this.#shuffleCursor = prevCursor;
        return this.jumpTo(this.#shuffleOrder[this.#shuffleCursor], autoPlay);
      }
      if (this.#repeat === 'all' || this.#repeat === 'one') {
        this.#shuffleCursor = this.#shuffleOrder.length - 1;
        return this.jumpTo(this.#shuffleOrder[this.#shuffleCursor], autoPlay);
      }
      return this.jumpTo(this.#shuffleOrder[0], autoPlay);
    }

    // Sequential mode
    const prevIndex = this.#currentIndex - 1;
    if (prevIndex >= 0) {
      return this.jumpTo(prevIndex, autoPlay);
    }

    if (this.#repeat === 'all' || this.#repeat === 'one') {
      return this.jumpTo(len - 1, autoPlay);
    }

    return this.jumpTo(0, autoPlay);
  }

  // ==================== REPEAT & SHUFFLE MODES ====================

  /**
   * Sets the repeat mode ('off' | 'all' | 'one').
   * @param {'off'|'all'|'one'} mode
   * @returns {'off'|'all'|'one'}
   */
  setRepeat(mode) {
    const normalized = typeof mode === 'string' ? mode.toLowerCase().trim() : '';
    if (!REPEAT_MODES.includes(normalized)) {
      throw new RangeError(`Invalid repeat mode "${mode}". Expected one of: ${REPEAT_MODES.join(', ')}`);
    }
    if (this.#repeat !== normalized) {
      this.#repeat = normalized;
      this.#emit('repeatChange', this.#repeat);
    }
    return this.#repeat;
  }

  /**
   * Cycles through repeat modes: 'off' -> 'all' -> 'one' -> 'off'.
   * @returns {'off'|'all'|'one'}
   */
  cycleRepeat() {
    const idx = REPEAT_MODES.indexOf(this.#repeat);
    const nextMode = REPEAT_MODES[(idx + 1) % REPEAT_MODES.length];
    return this.setRepeat(nextMode);
  }

  get repeat() {
    return this.#repeat;
  }

  set repeat(mode) {
    this.setRepeat(mode);
  }

  /**
   * Enables or disables shuffle playback.
   * @param {boolean} enabled
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  setShuffle(enabled) {
    const nextState = Boolean(enabled);
    if (this.#shuffle !== nextState) {
      this.#shuffle = nextState;
      this.#rebuildShuffleOrder();
      this.#emit('shuffleChange', this.#shuffle);
    }
    return this.#shuffle;
  }

  /**
   * Toggles shuffle mode on/off.
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  toggleShuffle() {
    return this.setShuffle(!this.#shuffle);
  }

  get shuffle() {
    return this.#shuffle;
  }

  set shuffle(enabled) {
    this.setShuffle(enabled);
  }

  #rebuildShuffleOrder(options = {}) {
    const len = this.#items.length;
    if (len === 0) {
      this.#shuffleOrder = [];
      this.#shuffleCursor = -1;
      return;
    }

    const indices = Array.from({ length: len }, (_, i) => i);

    if (!this.#shuffle) {
      this.#shuffleOrder = indices;
      this.#shuffleCursor = this.#currentIndex;
      return;
    }

    // Fisher-Yates shuffle
    for (let i = len - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      const tmp = indices[i];
      indices[i] = indices[j];
      indices[j] = tmp;
    }

    // Keep currently playing item at index 0 of the new shuffle cycle unless reshuffling at cycle end
    if (this.#currentIndex >= 0 && options.avoidFirstIndex === undefined) {
      const currentPosInShuffle = indices.indexOf(this.#currentIndex);
      if (currentPosInShuffle > 0) {
        indices.splice(currentPosInShuffle, 1);
        indices.unshift(this.#currentIndex);
      }
      this.#shuffleCursor = 0;
    } else if (options.avoidFirstIndex !== undefined && len > 1 && indices[0] === options.avoidFirstIndex) {
      const swapIdx = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (len - 1));
      const tmp = indices[0];
      indices[0] = indices[swapIdx];
      indices[swapIdx] = tmp;
      this.#shuffleCursor = 0;
    } else {
      this.#shuffleCursor = this.#currentIndex >= 0 ? indices.indexOf(this.#currentIndex) : 0;
    }

    this.#shuffleOrder = indices;
  }

  #syncShuffleCursorToCurrentIndex() {
    if (!this.#shuffle || this.#currentIndex === -1) {
      this.#shuffleCursor = this.#currentIndex;
      return;
    }
    const pos = this.#shuffleOrder.indexOf(this.#currentIndex);
    if (pos !== -1) {
      this.#shuffleCursor = pos;
    } else {
      this.#rebuildShuffleOrder();
    }
  }

  // ==================== SEARCH & FILTER ====================

  /**
   * Searches the playlist by matching query tokens against title, filePath, subtitlePath, and metadata.
   * Each returned item includes `playlistIndex` for direct use with `jumpTo(item.playlistIndex)`.
   * @param {string} query
   * @returns {Array<object>}
   */
  search(query) {
    if (typeof query !== 'string' || query.trim().length === 0) {
      return this.#items.map((item, idx) => ({
        ...item,
        metadata: { ...item.metadata },
        playlistIndex: idx
      }));
    }

    const tokens = query
      .toLowerCase()
      .trim()
      .split(/\s+/)
      .filter((t) => t.length > 0);

    const results = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < this.#items.length; i++) {
      const item = this.#items[i];
      const metaValues = item.metadata ? Object.values(item.metadata).join(' ') : '';
      const haystack = `${item.title} ${item.filePath} ${item.subtitlePath || ''} ${metaValues}`.toLowerCase();

      const matchesAllTokens = tokens.every((token) => haystack.includes(token));
      if (matchesAllTokens) {
        results.push({
          ...item,
          metadata: { ...item.metadata },
          playlistIndex: i
        });
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  // ==================== GETTERS & OBSERVER HOOKS ====================

  /**
   * Returns a shallow clone of all playlist items.
   * @returns {Array<object>}
   */
  getItems() {
    return this.#items.map((item, idx) => ({
      ...item,
      metadata: { ...item.metadata },
      playlistIndex: idx
    }));
  }

  get items() {
    return this.getItems();
  }

  get length() {
    return this.#items.length;
  }

  get count() {
    return this.#items.length;
  }

  get currentIndex() {
    return this.#currentIndex;
  }

  /**
   * Returns a copy of the currently active media item, or null.
   * @returns {object|null}
   */
  get currentItem() {
    if (this.#currentIndex < 0 || this.#currentIndex >= this.#items.length) {
      return null;
    }
    const item = this.#items[this.#currentIndex];
    return {
      ...item,
      metadata: { ...item.metadata },
      playlistIndex: this.#currentIndex
    };
  }

  /**
   * Subscribes to playlist events ('change', 'trackChange', 'repeatChange', 'shuffleChange').
   * @param {string} eventName
   * @param {Function} callback
   * @returns {Function} Unsubscribe function
   */
  subscribe(eventName, callback) {
    if (typeof eventName !== 'string' || typeof callback !== 'function') {
      throw new TypeError('PlaylistManager.subscribe requires an eventName and callback function.');
    }
    if (!this.#listeners.has(eventName)) {
      this.#listeners.set(eventName, new Set());
    }
    const set = this.#listeners.get(eventName);
    set.add(callback);
    return () => set.delete(callback);
  }

  #emit(eventName, ...args) {
    const set = this.#listeners.get(eventName);
    if (!set || set.size === 0) {
      return;
    }
    for (const fn of [...set]) {
      try {
        fn(...args);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(`[PlaylistManager] Error in "${eventName}" listener:`, error);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Cleans up StateManager subscriptions and DOM listeners.
   */
  destroy() {
    for (const unsub of this.#unsubscribers) {
      if (typeof unsub === 'function') {
        unsub();
      }
    }
    this.#unsubscribers = [];
    this.detachMediaElement();
    this.#listeners.clear();
  }
}

export const playlistManager = new PlaylistManager();
export default PlaylistManager;
```

```javascript
import { playerState } from './state.js';

export class PlaylistManager {
  #items = [];
  #currentIndex = -1;
  #repeat = 'off'; // 'off' | 'all' | 'one'
  #shuffle = false;
  #shuffleOrder = [];
  #shuffleCursor = -1;
  #state;
  #syncing = false;

  constructor(stateManager = playerState) {
    this.#state = stateManager;
    this.#state?.subscribe?.('ended', () => this.handleEnded());
    this.#state?.subscribe?.('duration', (d) => {
      if (this.#currentIndex >= 0 && this.#items[this.#currentIndex] && d > 0) {
        this.#items[this.#currentIndex].duration = d;
      }
    });
  }

  #normalize(item) {
    if (typeof item === 'string') {
      const filePath = item.trim();
      const title = filePath.split(/[\\/]/).pop().replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '') || 'Unbekannt';
      return { filePath, title, duration: 0, subtitlePath: null };
    }
    const filePath = (item?.filePath || item?.path || '').trim();
    if (!filePath) return null;
    const title = item.title?.trim() || filePath.split(/[\\/]/).pop().replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '');
    return {
      filePath,
      title,
      duration: Number(item.duration) > 0 ? Number(item.duration) : 0,
      subtitlePath: item.subtitlePath || null
    };
  }

  add(input) {
    const list = (Array.isArray(input) ? input : [input]).map((i) => this.#normalize(i)).filter(Boolean);
    this.#items.push(...list);
    this.#buildShuffleOrder();
    return list;
  }

  remove(index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.#items.length) return null;
    const [removed] = this.#items.splice(index, 1);
    if (!this.#items.length) {
      this.clear();
      return removed;
    }
    if (index < this.#currentIndex) {
      this.#currentIndex--;
    } else if (index === this.#currentIndex) {
      this.#currentIndex = Math.min(this.#currentIndex, this.#items.length - 1);
      this.#syncState(this.currentItem, Boolean(this.#state?.isPlaying));
    }
    this.#buildShuffleOrder();
    return removed;
  }

  clear() {
    this.#items = [];
    this.#currentIndex = -1;
    this.#shuffleOrder = [];
    this.#shuffleCursor = -1;
    this.#syncState(null, false);
  }

  jumpTo(index, autoPlay = true) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.#items.length) return null;
    this.#currentIndex = index;
    if (this.#shuffle) {
      this.#shuffleCursor = this.#shuffleOrder.indexOf(index);
    }
    const item = this.currentItem;
    this.#syncState(item, autoPlay);
    return item;
  }

  next(fromEnded = false) {
    const len = this.#items.length;
    if (!len) return null;
    if (fromEnded && this.#repeat === 'one' && this.#currentIndex !== -1) {
      return this.jumpTo(this.#currentIndex, true);
    }
    if (this.#currentIndex === -1) return this.jumpTo(0, true);

    if (this.#shuffle) {
      if (this.#shuffleCursor + 1 < len) {
        return this.jumpTo(this.#shuffleOrder[++this.#shuffleCursor], true);
      }
      if (this.#repeat === 'all') {
        this.#buildShuffleOrder();
        this.#shuffleCursor = 0;
        return this.jumpTo(this.#shuffleOrder[0], true);
      }
      this.#state?.pause?.();
      return null;
    }

    if (this.#currentIndex + 1 < len) return this.jumpTo(this.#currentIndex + 1, true);
    if (this.#repeat === 'all') return this.jumpTo(0, true);
    this.#state?.pause?.();
    return null;
  }

  previous() {
    const len = this.#items.length;
    if (!len) return null;
    if ((this.#state?.position || 0) > 3) {
      this.#state.setPosition(0);
      return this.currentItem;
    }
    if (this.#shuffle) {
      if (this.#shuffleCursor > 0) {
        return this.jumpTo(this.#shuffleOrder[--this.#shuffleCursor], true);
      }
      return this.#repeat === 'all'
        ? this.jumpTo(this.#shuffleOrder[(this.#shuffleCursor = len - 1)], true)
        : this.jumpTo(this.#shuffleOrder[0], true);
    }
    if (this.#currentIndex > 0) return this.jumpTo(this.#currentIndex - 1, true);
    return this.#repeat === 'all' ? this.jumpTo(len - 1, true) : this.jumpTo(0, true);
  }

  handleEnded() {
    return this.next(true);
  }

  setRepeat(mode) {
    if (['off', 'all', 'one'].includes(mode)) this.#repeat = mode;
    return this.#repeat;
  }

  setShuffle(enabled) {
    this.#shuffle = Boolean(enabled);
    this.#buildShuffleOrder();
    return this.#shuffle;
  }

  search(query = '') {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return this.#items.map((item, index) => ({ ...item, index }));
    return this.#items
      .map((item, index) => ({ ...item, index }))
      .filter((i) => `${i.title} ${i.filePath} ${i.subtitlePath || ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }

  #buildShuffleOrder() {
    this.#shuffleOrder = this.#items.map((_, i) => i);
    if (!this.#shuffle) return;
    for (let i = this.#shuffleOrder.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [this.#shuffleOrder[i], this.#shuffleOrder[j]] = [this.#shuffleOrder[j], this.#shuffleOrder[i]];
    }
    this.#shuffleCursor = Math.max(0, this.#shuffleOrder.indexOf(this.#currentIndex));
  }

  #syncState(item, isPlaying) {
    if (!this.#state || this.#syncing) return;
    this.#syncing = true;
    this.#state.setState({
      filePath: item ? item.filePath : null,
      currentFile: item ? item.filePath : null,
      position: 0,
      duration: item ? item.duration : 0,
      isPlaying
    });
    this.#syncing = false;
  }

  get items() { return [...this.#items]; }
  get currentIndex() { return this.#currentIndex; }
  get currentItem() { return this.#items[this.#currentIndex] || null; }
  get repeat() { return this.#repeat; }
  get shuffle() { return this.#shuffle; }
}

export const playlistManager = new PlaylistManager();
export default PlaylistManager;
```

```javascript
import { playerState } from './state.js';
import { subtitleParser } from './subtitles.js';
import { audioEngine } from './audio-engine.js';
import { thumbnailManager } from './thumbnails.js';
import { playlistManager } from './playlist.js';

export class UIManager {
  #els = {};
  #state;
  #audio;
  #subtitles;
  #thumbnails;
  #playlist;
  #unsubs = [];

  constructor({
    selectors = {},
    state = playerState,
    audio = audioEngine,
    subtitles = subtitleParser,
    thumbnails = thumbnailManager,
    playlist = playlistManager
  } = {}) {
    this.#state = state;
    this.#audio = audio;
    this.#subtitles = subtitles;
    this.#thumbnails = thumbnails;
    this.#playlist = playlist;
    this.bindElements(selectors);
    this.#bindDomEvents();
    this.#bindStateEvents();
    this.renderPlaylist();
  }

  bindElements(selectors = {}) {
    const map = {
      video: '#video-player, video',
      playBtn: '#btn-play, [data-action="play"]',
      prevBtn: '#btn-prev, [data-action="prev"]',
      nextBtn: '#btn-next, [data-action="next"]',
      muteBtn: '#btn-mute, [data-action="mute"]',
      timeline: '#seek-bar, #timeline',
      timeCurrent: '#time-current',
      timeTotal: '#time-total',
      volumeSlider: '#volume-slider',
      volumeLabel: '#volume-label',
      speedSelect: '#speed-select',
      subtitleOverlay: '#subtitle-overlay',
      thumbPreview: '#thumbnail-preview',
      thumbImg: '#thumbnail-img',
      thumbTime: '#thumbnail-time',
      playlistContainer: '#playlist-items, #queue-list',
      playlistSearch: '#playlist-search',
      ...selectors
    };

    for (const [key, sel] of Object.entries(map)) {
      this.#els[key] = typeof sel === 'string' ? document.querySelector(sel) : sel;
    }

    if (this.#els.video) {
      this.#audio?.attachMediaElement?.(this.#els.video);
      this.#thumbnails?.attachMediaElement?.(this.#els.video);
      this.#playlist?.attachMediaElement?.(this.#els.video);
    }
  }

  #bindDomEvents() {
    const {
      playBtn, prevBtn, nextBtn, muteBtn,
      timeline, volumeSlider, speedSelect,
      playlistContainer, playlistSearch
    } = this.#els;

    playBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => this.#state.togglePlay());
    prevBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => this.#playlist.previous());
    nextBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => this.#playlist.next());
    muteBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => this.#state.toggleMute());

    timeline?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      const targetTime = this.#resolveTimelineSeconds(Number(e.target.value));
      this.#audio.seek(targetTime);
    });

    timeline?.addEventListener('mousemove', async (e) => {
      const rect = timeline.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect.width || !this.#state.duration) return;
      const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width));
      const hoverSec = ratio * this.#state.duration;
      this.#updateThumbnailPreview(hoverSec, e.clientX - rect.left);
    });

    timeline?.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      if (this.#els.thumbPreview) this.#els.thumbPreview.hidden = true;
    });

    volumeSlider?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      this.#state.setVolume(Number(e.target.value));
    });

    speedSelect?.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      this.#state.setPlaybackSpeed(Number(e.target.value));
    });

    playlistSearch?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      this.renderPlaylist(e.target.value);
    });

    playlistContainer?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const itemEl = e.target.closest('[data-index]');
      if (!itemEl) return;
      const idx = Number(itemEl.dataset.index);
      if (e.target.closest('[data-remove]')) {
        this.#playlist.remove(idx);
      } else {
        this.#playlist.jumpTo(idx, true);
      }
      this.renderPlaylist(playlistSearch?.value || '');
    });
  }

  #bindStateEvents() {
    this.#unsubs.push(
      this.#state.subscribe('isPlaying', (playing) => this.updatePlayButton(playing)),
      this.#state.subscribe('position', (pos) => {
        this.updateTimeline(pos, this.#state.duration);
        this.updateSubtitle(pos);
      }),
      this.#state.subscribe('duration', (dur) => this.updateTimeline(this.#state.position, dur)),
      this.#state.subscribe('volume', (vol) => this.updateVolume(vol, this.#state.muted)),
      this.#state.subscribe('muted', (muted) => this.updateVolume(this.#state.volume, muted)),
      this.#state.subscribe('playbackSpeed', (speed) => this.updateSpeed(speed)),
      this.#state.subscribe('filePath', () => this.renderPlaylist(this.#els.playlistSearch?.value || ''))
    );

    if (typeof this.#playlist?.subscribe === 'function') {
      this.#unsubs.push(
        this.#playlist.subscribe('change', () => this.renderPlaylist(this.#els.playlistSearch?.value || '')),
        this.#playlist.subscribe('trackChange', () => this.renderPlaylist(this.#els.playlistSearch?.value || ''))
      );
    }
  }

  updatePlayButton(isPlaying) {
    const btn = this.#els.playBtn;
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.dataset.playing = String(Boolean(isPlaying));
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play');
    if (!btn.querySelector('svg')) {
      btn.textContent = isPlaying ? '⏸' : '▶';
    }
  }

  updateTimeline(position = 0, duration = 0) {
    const { timeline, timeCurrent, timeTotal } = this.#els;
    if (timeline) {
      const maxAttr = Number(timeline.max) || 100;
      if (maxAttr === 100 && duration > 0) {
        timeline.value = String((position / duration) * 100);
      } else {
        timeline.max = String(Math.max(1, Math.floor(duration)));
        timeline.value = String(Math.floor(position));
      }
    }
    if (timeCurrent) timeCurrent.textContent = this.formatTime(position);
    if (timeTotal) timeTotal.textContent = this.formatTime(duration);
  }

  updateSubtitle(currentTime) {
    const overlay = this.#els.subtitleOverlay;
    if (!overlay) return;
    const cue = this.#subtitles?.getSubtitleAt?.(currentTime);
    if (cue && cue.text) {
      overlay.textContent = cue.text;
      overlay.hidden = false;
    } else {
      overlay.textContent = '';
      overlay.hidden = true;
    }
  }

  updateVolume(volume, muted) {
    const { volumeSlider, volumeLabel, muteBtn } = this.#els;
    const effective = muted ? 0 : volume;
    if (volumeSlider) volumeSlider.value = String(effective);
    if (volumeLabel) volumeLabel.textContent = `${effective}%`;
    if (muteBtn) muteBtn.dataset.muted = String(Boolean(muted || volume === 0));
  }

  updateSpeed(speed) {
    if (this.#els.speedSelect) {
      this.#els.speedSelect.value = String(speed);
    }
  }

  async #updateThumbnailPreview(hoverSec, offsetX) {
    const { thumbPreview, thumbImg, thumbTime } = this.#els;
    if (!thumbPreview) return;
    thumbPreview.hidden = false;
    thumbPreview.style.left = `${Math.max(0, Math.round(offsetX))}px`;
    if (thumbTime) thumbTime.textContent = this.formatTime(hoverSec);

    const url = await this.#thumbnails?.getThumbnail?.(hoverSec);
    if (url && thumbImg) {
      thumbImg.src = url;
    }
  }

  renderPlaylist(query = '') {
    const container = this.#els.playlistContainer;
    if (!container || !this.#playlist) return;

    const list = query ? this.#playlist.search(query) : this.#playlist.items.map((item, index) => ({ ...item, index }));
    const activeIdx = this.#playlist.currentIndex;

    container.innerHTML = list
      .map((item) => {
        const idx = item.playlistIndex ?? item.index;
        const isActive = idx === activeIdx;
        const dur = item.duration > 0 ? this.formatTime(item.duration) : '';
        return `<div class="playlist-item${isActive ? ' active' : ''}" data-index="${idx}">
          <span class="playlist-title">${this.#escapeHtml(item.title)}</span>
          <span class="playlist-duration">${dur}</span>
          <button type="button" class="playlist-remove" data-remove="true" title="Entfernen">✕</button>
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');
  }

  #resolveTimelineSeconds(rawValue) {
    const timeline = this.#els.timeline;
    const duration = this.#state.duration || 0;
    if (!timeline || !duration) return 0;
    const maxAttr = Number(timeline.max) || 100;
    return maxAttr === 100 ? (rawValue / 100) * duration : rawValue;
  }

  formatTime(seconds) {
    const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(seconds) || 0));
    const hrs = Math.floor(s / 3600);
    const mins = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
    const secs = s % 60;
    const mm = String(mins).padStart(2, '0');
    const ss = String(secs).padStart(2, '0');
    return hrs > 0 ? `${hrs}:${mm}:${ss}` : `${mm}:${ss}`;
  }

  #escapeHtml(str = '') {
    return String(str)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
      .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }

  destroy() {
    this.#unsubs.forEach((fn) => fn?.());
    this.#unsubs = [];
  }
}

export default UIManager;
```
